replay.effort_assignment: world-local exposure index; round k updates world 0 then world 2 with effort_cycle[k mod 4]

probe.gradient_measurement: answer-only gradients for worlds 0 and 2 at the registered next-round effort from the identical pre-round state
probe.directed_update_measurement: from independent deep-cloned model+optimizer state, apply exactly one registered update to source world and evaluate both worlds at the same probe effort
probe.directed_damage_rule: source post-loss <= source pre-loss - self_improvement_epsilon and target post-loss >= target pre-loss + cross_damage_epsilon

interpretation.BIDIRECTIONAL_LOCAL_CROSS_DAMAGE: at least one registered probe in each direction shows a source-self-improving one-step update that increases the other world's same-effort answer-only loss beyond epsilon
interpretation.WORLD0_ONLY_LOCAL_CROSS_DAMAGE: registered direct cross-damage is observed only for world0 updates harming world2
interpretation.WORLD2_ONLY_LOCAL_CROSS_DAMAGE: registered direct cross-damage is observed only for world2 updates harming world0
interpretation.NO_REGISTERED_LOCAL_CROSS_DAMAGE: no registered one-step probe meets the preregistered direct cross-damage rule despite parent pair failure reproduction

nonclaims: EXP-329 does not establish universal gradient conflict
EXP-329 does not prove a global optimization mechanism outside the registered P02 trajectory
